ds000171.title: Neural Processing of Emotional Musical and Nonmusical Stimuli in Depression
ds000171.short_title: Emotional music vs nonmusic in MDD
ds000171.why: Core clinical contrast: limbic / auditory responses to emotional music in MDD vs controls; defines spectral biomarkers and responder score R.
ds000171.why_preprocess: Full BIDS events + BOLD already drive prepare_real_features.py (adaptive multitaper, tSNR, IsolationForest, condition epochs).
ds000171.integration: Feature store gold standard: spectral_features / condition_features / subject_features + R; ML bake-off + TF spectrogram models.
ds000171.cohort: 19 MDD (currently depressed) + 20 never-depressed controls; SCID; no meds at scan

ds002725.title: Joint EEG-fMRI during affective music listening
ds002725.why: Highest match for affective music listening. Healthy multimodal baseline to cross-validate ds000171 spectral biomarkers (BOLD PSD vs EEG) and limbic/auditory affect decoding.
ds002725.why_preprocess: Parallel per-subject BOLD (nibabel) + optional MNE EEG; Spark SQL for batch QC/fusion features; Delta provenance dataset_id=ds002725.
ds002725.integration: Align affect dimensions with pos/neg music; same multitaper bands + tSNR; flag rows with dataset_id; marimo cross-set EDA (healthy vs MDD maps).

ds003085.title: Temporal Dynamics of Emotional Music
ds003085.why: Direct emotional-music fMRI dynamics — temporal/spectral evolution of happy/sad BOLD vs ds000171 music valence contrasts.
ds003085.why_preprocess: Distributed epoching + multitaper/dynamic spectral features; Delta partitioned by valence; marimo filters by emotion.
ds003085.integration: Standardize valence labels; matching power/centroid bands; optional multi-dataset LOOCV / domain adaptation.

ds006564.title: Naturalistic film + controlled musical soundtracks
ds006564.why: Ecological music-in-context: predictive/memory effects in emotion/ToM networks overlapping limbic/auditory systems relevant to MDD.
ds006564.why_preprocess: Spark-scale naturalistic runs; music-property modulation features; Delta time-travel across soundtrack conditions.
ds006564.integration: Spectral features during music epochs; align predictive/emotion axes with ds000171 music contrasts.
ds006564.cohort: Film viewing with manipulated musical soundtracks; ToM / predictive priming

ds004894.title: HR and insula activity to music × interoceptive sensitivity
ds004894.why: Music emotion + peripheral HR + insula — ties to ds000171 anterior pseudo-ROIs and MDD interoception/emotion literature.
ds004894.why_preprocess: Parallel fMRI + physio sync; HRV + insula spectral features; Delta multimodal store.
ds004894.integration: Correlate HR with anterior/insula spectral proxies; extend R with interoception/HR features.

ds003720.title: Music Genre fMRI Dataset
ds003720.why: Non-emotional music-processing baseline vs emotion-specific design in ds000171; high within-subject reliability.
ds003720.why_preprocess: Spark parallel across runs/genres for spectral features; genre-level rollups.
ds003720.integration: Control comparison for non-emotional music structure; genre spectral embeddings.

ds004142.title: rt-fMRI neurofeedback reward valence
ds004142.why: Reward/saliency circuits related to anhedonia constructs.
ds004142.why_preprocess: Secondary clinical context; lighter music match.
ds004142.integration: Optional reward-network covariates; not primary music PSD.

ds005700.title: NeuroEmo emotion recognition
ds005700.why_preprocess: Lower priority for spectral music pipeline.
ds005700.integration: Optional domain for emotion labels only.
ds005700.cohort: Visual emotion with culturally relevant clips
